scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Industrial Parks: Stamp Duty
other_conditions: Eligibility is limited to Industries Associations or any enterprise registered under the Societies Act, Partnership Act, Trust Act, Companies Act, or a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) constituted for setting up an industrial park
benefits_summary: Developers receive 100% reimbursement of stamp duty on land purchase for the industrial park, while individual units in the park get 50% reimbursement of stamp duty on plot purchase.
